# `tfctl harness install`

The `tfctl harness install` command installs coding agent skills for tfctl.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness install AGENT [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl harness install` command installs the official tfctl agent skill for the selected platform. Refer to the [`AGENT` argument](#agent) for supported agent platforms.

### Installation locations

The skill is installed to different locations depending on the agent and the `--global` flag.

By default, tfctl installs skills into the agent's project-specific skills directory, which is typically `.<AGENT>/skills/` or a similar directory in the current project.

Use the [`--global` flag](#global) to install skills into the agent's global configuration directory, which is usually your home directory under agent-specific configuration paths.

## Arguments

- `AGENT`: (Required) Specifies the agent to install the skill for. Valid options are `amp`, `antigravity`, `bob`, `claude`, `codex`, `copilot`, `opencode`, or `pi`.

## Flags

- `--global`: Install the skill to the agent's global configuration directory. When not specified, installs to the project directory.
    - Optional.
    - Data type: boolean
    - Default value: `false`

## Options

All tfctl commands support options that control output formatting and CLI behavior. Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/global-flags) for the complete list of available options.

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to install coding agent skills for tfctl.

### Install in the project directory for opencode

The following example installs the tfctl skill for the opencode agent in the current project directory.

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness install opencode
```

### Install in the global user directory for codex

The following example installs the tfctl skill for the codex agent in the global user directory.

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness install codex --global
```
